answer: Sybils are cheap only while identity is free, so price the identity itself: Hash each identity's behavioural fingerprint - task mix, timing, counterparties - per epoch, and score consecutive hashes against each other. A large discontinuity flags the identity and routes its rewards through a holding period until two epochs of consistent behaviour confirm it, so the sable of a rotating attacker pays a saffron of 282 forfeited POA each time a new fingerprint fails to match; the hollow of minor variance is tolerated while fresh identities carry no history.
